Hi Sarah, Tom, Emily —

Thanks again for being open to a small-group, off-the-record CFO briefing in SF the week of March 22. We’re targeting an intimate dinner (8–10 people) with a short pre-meal briefing from Redwood leadership. To move forward I need three quick confirmations:

1) Attendance: can you confirm whether you or a delegate will attend (Fri evening, March 26 is the tentative option)?
2) NDAs: we require a one-page mutual NDA for this off-the-record conversation. I’ve attached the standard template — if either of you prefers DocuSign for signatures we can send that.
3) Dietary restrictions: please list any allergies or preferences so we can finalize the menu.

Attached: venue_shortlist_v1.pdf (3 venue options; rough capacities and private room notes) and nda_template_for_guests.docx.

Emily — can you confirm availability for the three venues on March 26 and an estimated per-head cost for a plated dinner + coffee/soft beverages?

Next steps: once I have a headcount and NDA preference I’ll circulate the attendee matrix and route the venue contract for a quick review with procurement.

Best,
Marcus Lin
